	country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
	societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist > 50
	NOT = {
		religion.group = religion_group:christian
		is_situation_active = situation:reformation
	}
	NOT = { societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist < -50 }
}

		}

			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 9 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:scientific_revolution
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 9 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_scientific_revolution_progressive
		}
	}
}
